the transfer of skill from dominant limb to non-diminant limb is better than vice versa for inexperienced male children.

the football basic technical training with unilateral leg could not improve transfer of skills to the non-dominant limb, and the football basic technical practice could not improve transfer from non-dominant to dominant limb.

the training of the non-dominant limb can be a useful method to improve the performance of both dominant and non-domiant limb for inexperienced male children.
